This is the second application filed by the applicant under Section 439 of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973 for grant of regular bail relating to Crime No.222/2022 registered at P.S. - Garoth,
District Mandsaur (M.P.) for commission of offence punishable under Section 376(2) (N), 365, 323,
109, 34 of IPC 2.

As per the prosecution story, on 22.5.2022 complainant Karan Singh lodged a missing report of his sister/prosecutrix before the police station Garoth by stating that his sister is married to present Mahendra Singh vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 19 June, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/88727155/

sentences.text: On 22.5.2022 when complainant Karan Singh went to meet his sister, her in-laws stated that she has left home on 20.5.2022 at around 6.00 p.m. and has not returned back.
Complainant tried to find her but failed to search her.
Thereafter, complainant registered missing person report.

During investigation police recovered the prosecutrix on 23.5.2022 and recorded her statement under Section 164 Cr.P.C.,
wherein she stated that on 20.5.2022 her husband Mahendra, her inlaws and husband's friend Laxman were present in the house and they beaten her.

Thereafter, relative of her in-laws Nepal Singh and one other person came to their house and Nepal Singh also inflicted injuries to prosecutrix and took her with him forcefully in his vehicle to village Pidawa and kept her in the hut of Narayan Singh for 3 days.
During this period, accused Nepal Singh committed rape on the prosecutrix.
Somehow prosecutrix escaped and reached to police station and lodged the report.
Accordingly a case has been registered against the present applicant and other co- accused persons.
3 . Learned counsel for the applicant submits that the applicant is an innocent person and he has been falsely implicated in this offence.
He is in custody since 5.8.2022.
He is husband of prosecutrix.
Prosecutrix has been examined before the trial court but she did not state anything against the applicant in respect of aforesaid offence.
The applicant is not the main accused who has committed rape upon prosecutrix.

Co-accused Labhu Bai has been enlarged on anticipatory bail by this court vide order dated 30.8.2022 passed in M.Cr.C. No. 40272/2022 and Nathu and Deepak have been enlarged on regular bail by this court vide orders dated 1.3.2023 and 27.9.2022 passed in M.Cr.C.
Nos. 3072/2023 and 41994/2022 in similar circumstances.
Applicant is permanent resident of District Mandsaur.
He is not having any criminal past.
Under the above circumstances, prayer for grant of bail may be considered on such terms and conditions, as this Court deems fit and proper.

4 . Per contra, learned counsel for the respondent / State opposes the bail application and prays for its rejection.
5.
Perused the impugned order of the trial Court as well as the case diary.

6. After considering all the facts and circumstances of the case, nature and gravity of offence,
arguments advanced by the learned counsel for the parties and also taking note of the fact that prosecutrix has been examined before the trial court and she did not state anything against the applicant in respect of aforesaid offence, applicant is husband of prosecutrix, co-accused Deepak and Nathu Singh have been enlarged on bail in similar circumstances, present applicant is not the main accused and final conclusion of the trial will take sufficient long time.
In these circumstances, I deem it proper to release the applicant on bail.
Therefore, without commenting on the merits of the case, the application is allowed.

7. It is directed that applicant be released on bail on his furnishing personal bond in the sum of Rs.75,000/- (Rupees Seventy Five Thousand Only) with one solvent surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court for his appearance before the trial Court, as and when required.

He shall abide by all the conditions enumerated under Section 437(3) Cr.P.C.
